text.description_html:
Imperial USA, Satin Brass 8 Inch Hands Free Door Stop

The Satin Brass 8 Inch Step On Door Holder is easy to operate. Simply install near the bottom of the door. Pressing down on the extra large foot pad actives the door stop, keeping the door in the open position. To deactivate the plunger door holder, simply press on the release tab with your foot--making the use of this spring loaded plunger doorstop completely hands free. It has a non-skid rubber tip to protect the floor. The Heavy Duty 8 Inch Hands Free Door Stop is easy to install. It comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Also available: 8 Inch Hands Free Door Stop in Aluminum or Dark Bronze & Replacement Rubber Tip.

Specifications and Features of the Heavy Duty Plunger Door Holder:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Satin Brass
  • Overall Length: 8"
  • Housing Body Length: 7"
  • Housing Body Width (at widest part): 1-1/2"
  • Housing Body Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Rubber Stop Length: 1"
  • Maximum Bolt Projection: 2"
  • Foot Pad: 1" x 1-1/2"
  • Rubber Color: Black
  • Polybagged with sheet metal screws.

Sold individually.
